description: Enable maintenance tracking per vehicle: users define custom maintenance items with mileage and/or time intervals and warning thresholds, seed an initial baseline to avoid instant anxiety, record service events that reset the clock, and see clear OK/Due Soon/Overdue statuses with an accordion-based maintenance tab and full edit/delete flows.

tasks.title: Maintenance domain model: items + records + events
tasks.description: Implement Maintenance vertical slice with event-sourced commands/events from Sprint 04: `DefineMaintenanceItemCommand` → `MaintenanceItemDefined` (includes initialLastPerformedDate/initialLastPerformedOdometer), `UpdateMaintenanceItemCommand` → `MaintenanceItemUpdated`, `RemoveMaintenanceItemCommand` → `MaintenanceItemRemoved`, `RecordMaintenanceCommand` → `MaintenancePerformed`, `UpdateMaintenanceRecordCommand` → `MaintenanceRecordUpdated`, `DeleteMaintenanceRecordCommand` → `MaintenanceRecordDeleted`. Ensure ownership is scoped by userId and IDs are UUIDs.
acceptanceCriteria: DefineMaintenanceItemCommand persists an item with defaults (mileageWarning=500, timeWarningDays=14 when omitted)
RecordMaintenanceCommand creates a service record and updates projections
Removing an item removes it (and its history) from the maintenance tab read model

tasks.title: Maintenance status engine (OK/DueSoon/Overdue + detail text)
tasks.description: Implement the status calculation logic exactly as specified in Sprint 04. Inputs: lastServiceDate/lastServiceOdometer (from most recent record, else initial state), estimatedCurrentMileage (for Sprint 04 use the raw most-recent odometer reading from any source), and currentDate (LocalDate). Apply mileage-based and time-based rules, with "worse status wins" when both are configured. Special case: items with no history and no initial state must show Due Soon (amber) with detail "No service history — log your first service to start tracking" (never Overdue). Build human-readable `statusDetail` strings matching the brief examples.
acceptanceCriteria: Items with no history and no initial state are Due Soon with the specified detail line
Combined intervals choose the worse status
Deleting the most recent service record recalculates status using the next most recent record (or initial state, or never-performed rule)

tasks.title: MaintenanceTabData projection + sorting
tasks.description: Create/read model projection `MaintenanceTabData { vehicleId, items, lastOdometer }` per contract. Items are sorted: overdue → dueSoon → ok; within each group alphabetical by item name. Each item includes records sorted reverse-chronological. Compute lastOdometer as the most recent odometer from any source (fuel logs or maintenance records).
acceptanceCriteria: MaintenanceTabData.items follow the specified urgency+alphabetical sorting
Maintenance records are reverse-chronological within an item
lastOdometer reflects the most recent reading across fuel logs and maintenance records

tasks.title: HTTP API contract for maintenance tab + commands
tasks.description: Define and implement the HTTP API surface for Sprint 04 (api-developer + backend-builder): fetch MaintenanceTabData, define/update/remove maintenance items, and record/update/delete service records. Ensure validation matches brief messages (name 1–100, intervals required, warning thresholds < interval, date not future, odometer bounds, notes length). Ensure ownership scoping and 404 semantics for cross-user access.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend can load MaintenanceTabData and receive status/statusDetail for each item
Validation errors match the brief requirements (interval required; warnings must be less than interval)

tasks.title: Maintenance UI: accordion list + add/edit item + log/edit service
tasks.description: Implement Vehicle Detail → Maintenance tab UI: urgency-sorted accordion cards with colored status dot, status detail, last performed line, and expanded service history with overflow menus. Implement pages: Add Maintenance Item (with collapsed "When to warn me" defaults and "Starting point" initial state fields), Edit Maintenance Item (no initial state section), Log Service, Edit Service Record. Implement confirmations: Remove Item confirmation dialog and Delete Service Record confirmation dialog with specified copy and toasts.
acceptanceCriteria: Maintenance items render as an accordion, sorted overdue→dueSoon→ok and then alphabetical
Add Item requires at least one interval (mileage/time) and supports initial state seeding
Logging service updates last performed and status detail immediately after returning to the tab

tasks.title: Tests: status logic + key UI flows
tasks.description: Add tests for Sprint 04: backend unit/integration tests for status transitions (mileage-only, time-only, combined, never-performed behavior) and record deletion fallback behavior; plus an automated UI test (Playwright preferred) that defines an item, logs service, and verifies status updates.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend tests cover never-performed → Due Soon behavior and combined-interval worse-status selection
Backend tests cover deleting latest record and recalculating based on previous record/initial state
Automated UI test covers add item → log service → see updated last performed line
